label: review-CC2
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
summary_path=Path("results/p5/CC2-all-configurations.json")
summary=json.loads(summary_path.read_text());assert summary["status"]=="passed"
expected={("scan","stdpq")} | {(mode,kernel) for mode in ("indexed","auto") for kernel in ("stdpq","binheap","quad","loser")}
excluded=set(summary["excluded_mode_specific_fields"])
results={};details=[]
for preset,seeds in (("release",1000),("asan-ubsan",200)):
 rows=[row for row in summary["rows"] if row["preset"]==preset]
 assert len(rows)==9 and {(r["mode"],r["kernel"]) for r in rows}==expected
 canonical=[]
 for row in rows:
  record_path=Path(row["record"]);record=json.loads(record_path.read_text())
  assert record["status"]=="passed" and record["exit_code"]==0
  argv=record["argv"]
  for option,value in (("--seeds",str(seeds)),("--operations","10000"),("--seed-base","20191230"),("--mode",row["mode"]),("--kernel",row["kernel"])):
   assert argv[argv.index(option)+1]==value
  if preset=="asan-ubsan":
   assert "detect_leaks=1" in record["environment"]["ASAN_OPTIONS"] and "halt_on_error=1" in record["environment"]["UBSAN_OPTIONS"]
  log_path=Path(record["log"]);log=log_path.read_text()
  assert not any(marker in log for marker in ("ERROR: AddressSanitizer","ERROR: LeakSanitizer","runtime error:","UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer:"))
  payload=json.loads(next(line for line in reversed(log.splitlines()) if line.startswith("{")))
  assert payload==row["result"] and payload["status"]=="passed"
  assert payload["operations"]==seeds*10000 and payload["seeds"]==seeds and payload["operations_per_seed"]==10000
  if row["mode"]!="scan":
   assert payload["indexed_execution_batches"]>0 and payload["multicursor_opens"]>0
  if row["mode"]=="auto":assert payload["scan_execution_batches"]>0
  canonical.append({k:v for k,v in payload.items() if k not in excluded})
  details.append({"preset":preset,"mode":row["mode"],"kernel":row["kernel"],"record":str(record_path),"record_sha256":hashlib.sha256(record_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"log_sha256":hashlib.sha256(log_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"indexed_execution_batches":payload["indexed_execution_batches"],"scan_execution_batches":payload["scan_execution_batches"],"multicursor_opens":payload["multicursor_opens"]})
 assert all(p==canonical[0] for p in canonical)
 results[preset]={"configurations":len(rows),"operations":9*seeds*10000,"same_observable_results":True,"digest":canonical[0]["digest_fnv1a64"]}
rc3=json.loads(Path("results/p5/rc3-summary.json").read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(Path("build/release/tiplog_differential").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==rc3["builds"]["gcc"]["binaries"]["tiplog_differential"]
for filename,digest in rc3["source_sha256"].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
out={"status":"passed","scope":"Independent saved CC2 evidence audit; no differential campaign rerun","summary_sha256":hashlib.sha256(summary_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"preset_results":results,"effective_execution_and_multicursor_coverage_checked":True,"current_release_binary_rc3_and_source_identity":True,"rows":details}
Path("results/p5/CC2-independent-review.json").write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k!="rows"}))
